name: Sleep Through Night
description: Close your eyes, relax deeply, and sleep peacefully for several hours.
ongoingMessage: Deep, restorative sleep takes over. Dreams drift by quietly as the world outside rests.
successMessage: You wake up feeling thoroughly refreshed and rejuvenated. The morning awaits!

name: Take a Power Nap
description: Rest your eyes for 45 minutes to recharge your batteries.
successMessage: You wake up from a crisp power nap with your head feeling much clearer.

name: Cook Fresh Meal
description: Saute spices, make fresh hot rotis and fragrant dal on the stove.
successMessage: The kitchen fills with mouthwatering aromas! A steaming hot pot of dal and fresh rotis are bubbling on the stove.

name: Serve Meal onto Plate
description: Ladle hot dal, rice, and fresh rotis from the stove onto your steel plate.
successMessage: You ladle steaming fragrant dal, fluffy rice, and warm soft phulkas onto the steel thali plate. A complete, wholesome meal is ready to be enjoyed.

name: Eat Meal from Plate
description: Sit comfortably on the kitchen dining stool and enjoy your home-cooked meal from the plate.
successMessage: You enjoy every bite of the hot dal, rice, and freshly puffed rotis. Warmth and contentment spread through you as your hunger is completely satisfied.

name: Cook Breakfast (Poha & Aloo Paratha)
description: Prepare a classic Jabalpur morning breakfast: temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, and crunchy peanuts for soft lemon poha, or griddle crisp golden aloo parathas on the tawa.
ongoingMessage: Mustard seeds splutter cheerfully in hot oil with curry leaves, spreading the appetizing morning aroma of fresh breakfast...
successMessage: You slide fragrant, turmeric-golden poha onto the counter, topped with crisp sev, finely chopped onions, and a squeeze of fresh lemon. Breakfast is served!

name: Eat Home-Cooked Meal
description: Sit down and enjoy a delicious, fulfilling warm meal.
successMessage: Mmm, that was delicious and wholesome. You feel completely satisfied and energized.

name: Eat Quick Snack
description: Grab a fruit or quick snack from the fridge or counter.
successMessage: You munch on a fresh snack. Just what you needed to keep going.

name: Work at Computer
description: Sit down and work at the computer.
successMessage: You settle into focused work at the computer.

name: Read Book
description: Pick a book from the shelf or read your carried book in bed under the lamp.
successMessage: You read several illuminating chapters. A peaceful, enriching escape.

name: Use Toilet
description: Relieve your bladder comfortably.
successMessage: Ah, what a relief. Bladder completely empty.

name: Wash Face with Cold Water
description: Splash cool water from the washbasin tap across your face.
successMessage: The brisk, cold water splashes across your cheeks and forehead. Instant awake boost!

name: Brush Teeth
description: Brush your teeth thoroughly with minty herbal toothpaste.
successMessage: You brush thoroughly until every tooth feels smooth and clean, rinsing your mouth with cool water. Your breath is delightfully minty and fresh.

name: Take a Refreshing Shower
description: Step under the rain shower for a warm, soothing bath.
successMessage: Warm streams of water massage your shoulders and wash away all tiredness. Thick steam rises and blankets the mirror in a warm haze. You feel spotless and reborn.

name: Take a Steaming Hot Shower
description: Turn up the geyser and soak under a deeply relaxing, hot rain shower.
successMessage: Luxuriously hot water envelops your body in comforting steam, turning the bathroom mirror completely foggy and melting away every muscle ache.

name: Take a Brisk Cold Shower
description: Step under the cold shower to wake up your body and sharpen your senses.
successMessage: The sharp, cold torrent shocks your skin in the best way possible! An electric jolt of alertness surges through your veins.

name: Dry Off with Towel
description: Use the soft cotton bath towel from the rack to dry yourself thoroughly from head to toe.
successMessage: You wrap yourself in the soft cotton towel, patting your skin completely dry. The warmth and cleanliness feel wonderfully comforting.

name: Apply Moisturizer
description: Gently massage soothing herbal moisturizer across your face and neck.
successMessage: You massage a dab of cooling moisturizer into your face and neck. Your skin feels nourished, supple, and refreshed.

name: Wash Hair
description: Lather your hair with nourishing herbal shampoo and rinse thoroughly with clean water.
successMessage: You massage herbal shampoo into a rich lather, washing away dirt and oils before rinsing clean. Your scalp feels cool and invigorated.

name: Sweep Floor
description: Use the grass broom to sweep away dust, lint, and debris across the room.
successMessage: You sweep the floor with smooth, rhythmic strokes of the grass broom, gathering all dust into a neat pile. The room looks spotless and peaceful.

name: Meditate Peacefully
description: Close your eyes, breathe deeply, and center your thoughts in mindful calm.
successMessage: Ten minutes of quiet presence. Your mind slows down, leaving you grounded and at peace.

name: Brew Fresh Hot Tea
description: Simmer classic Assam tea leaves, fresh milk, and a spoonful of sugar over the gas flame for a simple, comforting cup of everyday normal tea.
ongoingMessage: The pot gently bubbles on the stove as regular tea leaves simmer into creamy milk...
successMessage: You strain the steaming, comforting cup of fresh hot tea. Clean, sweet, and perfectly simple.

name: Brew Normal Tea
description: Brew a straightforward, hot cup of everyday milk tea with Assam tea leaves, milk, and sugar.
ongoingMessage: The pot bubbles gently on the stove as regular tea leaves simmer into creamy milk...
successMessage: You pour a hot, soothing cup of normal milk tea. Familiar, simple, and satisfying.

name: Brew Hot Tea for Two
description: Brew two classic cups of steaming milk tea with rich Assam leaves, fresh milk, and sugar to share with Aria in the kitchen.
ongoingMessage: Two cups of simple hot tea simmer together on the stove, warming the kitchen...
successMessage: You pour two steaming mugs of freshly brewed hot milk tea. Simple, warm, and deeply comforting for both of you.

name: Sip Hot Chai
description: Take a warm, comforting sip of freshly brewed milk tea from the chai cup.
successMessage: You take a slow sip of the warm, soothing tea. Its rich aroma brings immediate comfort.

name: Drink Entire Cup of Chai
description: Finish the entire cup of hot milk tea, relishing the spices down to the last drop.
successMessage: You finish the cup of tea, feeling wonderfully rejuvenated, refreshed, and warm.

name: Write in Journal
description: Open your personal diary and jot down morning thoughts and plans.
successMessage: The quiet scratching of pen on paper brings clarity to your morning thoughts.

name: Morning Body Stretch
description: Stand tall, interlace fingers overhead, and stretch your spine and calves thoroughly.
successMessage: A deep satisfying stretch rolls through your shoulders and spine, clearing remaining sluggishness.

name: Tidy Up Space
description: Straighten blankets, align desk items, and return scattered objects to their places.
successMessage: Everything looks neat, balanced, and orderly now. The room breathes easier.

name: Relax on Sofa
description: Rest peacefully on the living room sofa, letting go of all the day's tension.
successMessage: You lean back into the deep cushions, closing your eyes and savoring the quiet calm.

name: Watch TV
description: Watch an engaging travel show or movie on the living room television.
successMessage: You enjoy an engrossing show on the screen, losing yourself in the story.

name: Step Out onto Balcony
description: Walk up to the balcony railing to take in the open air.
successMessage: You step right up to the railing. A gust of fresh breeze greets you warmly.

name: Lean on Balcony Railing
description: Rest your elbows on the cool balcony railing and watch the Jabalpur skyline.
successMessage: You lean over the railing, observing the treetops swaying in the breeze and taking in the peaceful neighborhood views.

name: Water Balcony Plants
description: Use the watering can to generously hydrate the thirsty potted plants.
successMessage: You pour gentle showers of water over each planter. The soil turns dark and moist, releasing a wonderful earthy petrichor aroma.

name: Smell Jasmine Flowers
description: Lean in and take in the delicate, sweet fragrance of the blooming flowers.
successMessage: The sweet, calming perfume of fresh jasmine fills your lungs, instantly soothing your mind.

name: Change Clothes
description: Select an outfit from the open wardrobe and change into fresh clothes.
successMessage: You change into fresh clothes from the wardrobe. You feel composed, confident, and refreshed.

name: Change into Sleepwear
description: Change into a soft cotton kurta-pyjama or shorts, ideal for sleeping and lounging.
successMessage: You slip into the soft cotton kurta-pyjama. It feels wonderfully light and comforting.

name: Change into Casual Loungewear
description: Change into a comfortable t-shirt and track pants for relaxing around the house.
successMessage: You put on a fresh comfortable t-shirt and grey track pants. Ready for relaxed hours at home.

name: Change into Outdoor / Work Wear
description: Change into a crisp linen shirt and tailored trousers, sharp and presentable for work or going out.
successMessage: You button up the crisp linen shirt and slip into tailored trousers. You look sharp and feel confident.

name: Bedtime Reading
description: Read your carried book while resting in bed under the warm golden glow of the bedside lamp.
successMessage: You read peacefully in bed under the bedside lamp's mellow glow. The words soothe your thoughts as the bedroom settles into late night calm.

name: Work on Coding Project
description: Develop software projects—writing clean code, solving algorithmic bugs, and compiling builds.
successMessage: You dive deep into the codebase. Terminal tests run green, architecture aligns cleanly, and you feel a profound rush of productive satisfaction (+20 studiousness, +10 energy satisfaction, -15 boredom).

name: Listen to Lo-Fi Music
description: Stream mellow, nostalgic lo-fi study beats to enhance focus and wash away fatigue.
successMessage: Warm, crackling lo-fi jazz beats drift gently around your desk, creating an oasis of calm that melts away tension (-15 stress, +10 happiness).

name: Offer Cup of Chai to Roommate
description: Share a warm, aromatic cup of freshly brewed ginger-cardamom chai with Aria.
successMessage: You hand a steaming, fragrant cup of freshly made chai to Aria. She takes a comforting sip with a grateful smile: 'Thank you, Mohit! Exactly what I needed.' Roommate rapport deepens warmly.

name: Ask Aria About Her Day
description: Check in warmly with your roommate about how her studies, projects, and day have been unfolding.
successMessage: You take a moment to ask Aria about her day. She relaxes her posture, shares little highlights, and listens attentively to yours. A natural bond of easy camaraderie settles in.

name: Play Chess with Aria
description: Sit down across the Sheesham wooden board for a quiet, tactical game of chess.
successMessage: Pawns clash in the center, rooks slide open files, and a quiet, respectful battle of minds unfolds across the wooden board. Aria laughs when you counter her queen flank attack: 'Well played!'

name: Discuss Book with Aria
description: Exchange thoughts and intriguing insights from your recent reading.
successMessage: You discuss chapter themes and conceptual ideas with Aria. Her analytical perspective adds fascinating new angles to what you've read (+10 studiousness, +10 sociability, -15 boredom).

name: Discuss Code Architecture with Aria
description: Share ideas on software design, algorithms, and system architecture with your roommate.
successMessage: You whiteboard a module structure and walk Aria through your code design. Her feedback is sharp and insightful, sparking fresh enthusiasm for your work (+10 studiousness, +10 sociability).
